projectMove.title: Carnival: Confirm Hub login before Online Check-In opens
projectMove.body: Online Check-In for Carnival Paradise opens Saturday, October 18, which is six days from today. A five-minute check that Carnival Hub still recognizes booking FM3V62, and that your phone can open the app without fighting a password reset, keeps October 18 from becoming a scramble before the Tallahassee bus night.

tip.title: Use tonight’s Russian block for phrases you will need aboard
tip.body: Spend part of the two-hour Russian session on short travel lines you can say without thinking, like asking for directions, ordering food, and checking a price. Saying them out loud a few times tonight makes them easier when the ship and ports are loud.

extras.cruiseNote: The Carnival trip runs October 31 to November 5, with the Tallahassee bus leaving the night of October 31. Online check-in opens October 18, six days from today, and a reminder is already set for that morning.
extras.weatherNote: Mainly sunny and hot, with little chance of rain. High near 89F and low near 61F, with light northwest winds, so plan for heat if you are outside mid-day.

surprise.title: Tonight's golden hour: 6:39 PM–7:11 PM ET
surprise.body: Zae, the light softens over Tallahassee from 6:39 to 7:11 this evening, and I would gladly hold that window for a Grad Arena shoot if you would like the gold on your side.
